notes: «عن جده الحسن بن راشد»: «جده» plus a name is one link, surface the name alone (rule 7).
Honorifics «(رضي الله عنه)», «(رحمه الله)», «(2)» (a footnote marker) and the leading «3 -» number are left out.
Abu Sa'id is the last link: he relays the Prophet's answer; the Prophet is the end of the chain.
